name: Multi-Strategy Embeddings (Feature 3)
description: Extend the embedding system to support multiple named strategies that populate Signal.embeddings dict. Define EmbeddingStrategy protocol. Implement at least 3 strategies: semantic (general LLM, fallback to keyword vectors), technical (code-aware keyword extraction + TF-IDF), social (author/mention graph embedding). All strategies produce same fixed dimensionality (EMBEDDING_DIM=64). Each context learns which dimensions are most predictive via feedback. Familiarity score uses per-context dimension weights. Composes three sub-contracts: embedding_strategy_protocol (registry + protocol), embedding_strategy_implementations (semantic/technical/social strategies), and embedding_context_weights (per-context dimension weight learning).

functions.description: Shared hashing utility. Computes a deterministic (bucket, sign) pair from a token string using hashlib.md5. functions.name: record_acceptance
functions.description: Update dimension weights in-place based on a signal acceptance event (ART match-based learning). Computes per-strategy similarity contributions, then adjusts logits: logit_i += effective_lr * (contribution_i - mean_contribution). This is zero-sum across strategies.
